payload.prompt: Os custos totais aumentaram significativamente de janeiro a fevereiro de 2026. Analise o livro razão e identifique as três contas de despesa com o maior aumento em valor. Crie um projeto interno para cada uma das três contas com o nome da conta. Também crie uma atividade para cada projeto.

payload.goal: Analyze the general ledger to identify the three expense accounts with the largest cost increase from January to February 2026, then create one internal project per account (named after the account) and one activity per project.
success_checks: Ledger queried for expense accounts comparing January 2026 vs February 2026 balances
Top 3 expense accounts by absolute increase identified
Three internal projects created, each named after one of the identified accounts
One activity created for each of the three projects
All projects marked as internal type
risk_notes: Sandbox is empty — no ledger data exists yet; real ledger data must be available in the target environment for analysis to be meaningful
Account names are unknown until ledger is queried; project names cannot be pre-filled
It is unclear whether 'increase in value' means absolute increase or percentage increase — assuming absolute monetary increase
Activity details (name, type, rate) are not specified in the prompt; defaults or placeholders will be needed
Project manager and department are not specified; may be required fields depending on Tripletex configuration
payload.suggested_first_action: GET /ledger/account?isActive=true to retrieve all expense accounts, then query /ledger?dateFrom=2026-01-01&dateTo=2026-01-31 and /ledger?dateFrom=2026-02-01&dateTo=2026-02-28 to compare balances per account.
ordered_steps: 1. GET /ledger/account?isActive=true&isApplicableForSupplierInvoice=false to list all expense accounts
2. GET /ledger?dateFrom=2026-01-01&dateTo=2026-01-31&groupBy=ACCOUNT to retrieve January 2026 totals per account
3. GET /ledger?dateFrom=2026-02-01&dateTo=2026-02-28&groupBy=ACCOUNT to retrieve February 2026 totals per account
4. Compute delta (February total - January total) for each expense account and sort descending by absolute increase
5. Select top 3 accounts with the highest absolute increase
6. POST /project for Project 1: {name: <Account1Name>, isInternal: true, projectType: 'INTERNAL'}
8. POST /project for Project 2: {name: <Account2Name>, isInternal: true, projectType: 'INTERNAL'}
10. POST /project for Project 3: {name: <Account3Name>, isInternal: true, projectType: 'INTERNAL'}
12. Verify all three projects and activities are created via GET /project?name=<AccountName>

planned_endpoints.summary: Create customer. Related customer addresses may also be created.
Find employees corresponding with sent data.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
Do NOT send isCustomer (it's readOnly and auto-set).
For addresses, use postalAddress={addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161}} for Norway.
Requires name and departmentNumber.
ALWAYS search first: GET /employee?email=<email> — the sandbox often has pre-existing employees. Reuse if found.
Only POST /employee if GET returns 0 results.
When POSTing, ALWAYS include department={"id": dept_id}. Create department first if needed.
userType should be 'NO_ACCESS' (safest default — avoids 422 errors). Only use 'STANDARD' if email login is explicitly needed.
startDate is a TOP-LEVEL field on the employee object. Do NOT put it inside an employments array.
dateOfBirth is a TOP-LEVEL field. Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
jobTitle is set via PUT /employee/{id} AFTER creation — it cannot be set in the initial POST.
Do NOT include an 'employments' array in POST /employee — employment details go via separate POST /employee/employment endpoint.

For occupation codes (STYRK/yrkeskode): POST /employee/employment first, then GET /employee/employment/occupationCode?nameAndCode=XXXX to find the code, then PUT /employee/employment/details to set it.
Requires customer={"id": customer_id} and projectManager={"id": employee_id}.
startDate is REQUIRED — set to 2026-01-01 or earlier to allow timesheet entries on any date.
If the prompt mentions a project number (prosjektnummer), set number=<project_number>.
isInternal should be false unless explicitly stated as internal project.
For project BUDGET/fixed-price amount, use field name fixedPrice (camelCase) — NEVER fixedprice.
For fixed-price projects, set isFixedPrice=true and fixedPrice=<amount> in the same request.
When prompt explicitly says fixed-price project, set projectCategory='FIXED_PRICE' (or matching enum value from schema if required).
Requires project={"id": project_id} and activity={"id": activity_id}.
If activity already linked (409), ignore the error and proceed.
If a default hourly rate already exists (409 Duplicate entry), GET /project/hourlyRates?projectId=... then PUT to update it.
For fixed rate: hourlyRateModel='TYPE_FIXED_HOURLY_RATE', fixedRate=<rate>.

1. The task is in Portuguese and asks me to analyze the general ledger to find the three expense accounts with the largest cost increase from January to February 2026
2. Then create an internal project for each of those three accounts, named after the account
3. Also create an activity for each project

1. First, I need to query the ledger postings for January 2026 and February 2026 to find expense accounts with the largest increases

3. I'll use the aggregate_endpoint tool to get totals by account for each month


4. Then I'll calculate the differences between the two months and identify which three accounts had the biggest increases

Now I'm going to pull the aggregated ledger data for both January and February 2026 to compare the expense account totals.
